_comment: provenance MUST be 'measured' for an entry to be installable. A 'computed' entry fits a
capacity calculation and has never been run; offering one would offer a configuration
nobody has tested. 128 streams fit the arithmetic on a 3090 and took the container with it.
min_per_device_bytes is not derivable from min_total_bytes: a layer must fit on the device
holding it, so six 12 GiB cards do not substitute for two 24 GiB ones.

entries.note: 728.71 tok/s aggregate at depth 0 on a good node, 564.16 on a typical one; library tg128 138.40 and 119.31 respectively. Built with GGML_CUDA_FORCE_MMQ=ON. 72 streams collapsed on one node, 128 killed the process.
